input_provenance.source_basis: Hospital experimenter confirmation, as communicated by the study authors.
input_provenance.source_statement: U-TEG MA and curves are original measured values.
input_provenance.runtime_input: U-TEG inputs are indexed on a 900-point grid at one-second intervals (15 minutes). The 5- and 10-minute windows cover the first 300 and 600 grid points. Processing masks identify the points retained for fitting. The runner loads saved early fits and stored full-record coefficients; parameter preparation precedes model evaluation.
